title: Sidebar: Personal workspace, comfortable
note: Default state. Dusk tint, favorites, pinned folders two levels deep, a pinned tab away from its pinned page, sleeping and audio tabs.

title: Sidebar: Work workspace
note: Tide tint in the default theme (Vivid), different favorites, pinned and Today content, folders in both sections.

title: Sidebar: Side project workspace
note: Moss tint in the default theme (Vivid), small favorites set, a collapsed folder in Today.

title: Sidebar: compact density
note: 28px rows, 36px tiles, 4px content inset.

title: Sidebar: collapsed rail
note: 56px rail: icon favorites, favicon-only tabs, vertical workspace dots.

title: Sidebar: auto-hide, peeking
note: Sidebar hidden; floating peek panel over the page from the edge hot zone.

title: Sidebar: on the right
note: Everything mirrored; window controls stay at the outer edge.

title: Command bar
note: Centred bar over a dimmed page with workspace, tab and archive results.

title: Tab context menu
note: Pin, Rename, Add to Favorites, Move to workspace, Sleep now, Close.

title: Archive panel
note: Stub panel: Archived tabs with a search field.

title: Focus order overlay
note: Numbered badges for tab and screen-reader order.

title: Guard shield popover
note: Stub popover from the address pill: Guard panel, see Guard design.

title: Theme Vivid: Personal workspace
note: Theme Vivid: default; strong Workspace gradient across sidebar and frame. Personal (Dusk).

title: Theme Soft: Personal workspace
note: Theme Soft: gentle Workspace gradient. Personal (Dusk).

title: Theme Clean: Personal workspace
note: Theme Clean: near-neutral frame, identity via accent and a thin gradient strip. Personal (Dusk).

title: Theme OLED: Personal workspace
note: Theme OLED: dark only; pure black, hairline card, no gradients (screenshot dark only). Personal (Dusk).

title: Theme High contrast: Personal workspace
note: Theme High contrast: text 7:1 or better, 2px borders on selected rows and focus, solid strip and marker. Personal (Dusk).

title: Theme Mono: Personal workspace
note: Theme Mono: greyscale; hue only in the active Workspace icon. Personal (Dusk).
